inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. Organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, the Together Alliance event was billed as the biggest [...] The post Protesters rally in London against UK far-right rise appeared first on Digital Journal .
inputs.modified_text: Well, folks, we are seeing it with our own eyes once again. Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday for this so-called Together Alliance event, billed as the biggest [...] just weeks ahead of key local elections. This comes six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations. This radical mob of trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies is out in the streets attempting to disrupt our traditional social order, undermine our heritage, and bully the public right before they head to the ballot box. Instead of promoting personal responsibility and preserving time-tested British values, these progressive agitators are manufacturing division and pandering to special interests to seize political power. We have got to stand firm for cultural continuity and law and order against this constant pressure.

rationales.entity_drift: The same marchers, groups, event, and locations remain; the modified text mainly adds hostile labels rather than substituting actors.
rationales.relation_drift: The original says people marched to protest the far-right and groups organized the event; the modified text instead attributes disruptive and power-seeking intentions to the groups.
rationales.contradiction_drift: The modified text contains no clear internal contradiction.
